reason: The cited evidence shows that adiabatic shear bands can form in some HEAs at high strain rates (E2), but it does not mention FeNiCrMn, penetration properties, or the specific temperature/strain-rate boundaries. No cited passage supports the claim that ASBs enhance penetration, nor that FeNiCrMn retains comparable mechanical performance to CoCrFeMnNi. The premises are therefore largely unsupported by the provided evidence.
